title: Run your agents on your own Azure OpenAI resource
description: An account admin can connect an Azure OpenAI resource on Settings > Model providers with its endpoint, API version, region and key, or set it at install with OPENAI_API_TYPE=azure, OPENAI_API_BASE, OPENAI_API_VERSION, OPENAI_API_REGION and OPENAI_API_KEY. A call answered from another region than the one you named is flagged on the connection and in the call log.
